translation: If one falls from a carriage or horse and the palm of the hand lands on the ground, only the wrist can be injured; if the fingers land on the ground and the fingers turn and stick to the arm, then the wrist seam must separate. For an injured wrist, with congested swelling and pain, the method is to knead and rub the wrist with both hands, administer Zhenggu Zijin Dan (Bone-Setting Purple-Gold Pill, 正骨紫金丹) internally, and apply Wanling Gao (Myriad-Efficacy Plaster, 萬靈膏) externally. If the back of the hand turns backward and sticks to the arm, use both hands to hold the back of the hand and gently turn it back to restore its position, then still massage the sinews and must make them harmonious and smooth; administer Renshen Zijin Dan (Ginseng Purple-Gold Pill, 人參紫金丹) internally, and apply Hunyuan Gao (Primordial Chaos Plaster, 混元膏) externally. <ins>Zhenggu Zijin Dan</ins> <ins>Wanling Gao</ins> <ins>Hunyuan Gao</ins> (all seen in the injury of the vertex bone) <ins>Renshen Zijin Dan</ins> (seen in the injury of the shanjiao bone).
